_readme: Cutscenes. See README 'Cutscenes'. Actors: 'player' or an NPC's Name from Tiled. Positions are tiles [x, y].

say: Ah, you're finally awake! Welcome to Brightwater, Wayfarer.
steps.speaker: Elder

say: A hundred years ago the Hollow King sealed the Sun Road with four dungeons...
The first lies just over there. The Mossy Catacombs.
steps.speaker: Elder

say: Many have gone in. Nobody has ever come out the other side.
Beat its keeper and break the seal, and the road to Ashford opens.
steps.speaker: Elder

say: Visit the shop and the healer before you go. And take this.
steps.speaker: Elder

say: A traveler? From the south? You came through the Shadow Crypt?!
Welcome to Frostholm, friend.
steps.speaker: Guard

say: Up north is the Frost Cavern. The Frost Wyrm guards the third seal...
Use the bombs from the crypt on cracked ice. And dress warm!
steps.speaker: Guard

say: The Hollow King lets out a long, empty sigh... and crumbles into light.
One by one, the four seals turn to dust. Far away, in Brightwater, Ashford, Frostholm and Sunspire, the people look up.
The Sun Road is free. The dungeons no one could conquer have been conquered, by you.
(Thanks for playing! You can keep exploring: every chest and room is still out there.)
Halt! ...You came up the old road? Through the Catacombs?
Nobody has done that in a hundred years! Welcome to Ashford, Wayfarer!
steps.speaker: Guard

say: The second seal is in the Shadow Crypt, north of town. Talk to our Scholar before you go.
steps.speaker: Guard

say: The road... it's open? Then the seals really are breaking!
Welcome to Sunspire, Wayfarer. Our Sage has been waiting for you.
steps.speaker: Guard

say: The Hollow Spire rises north of the city. The King himself waits at the top.
steps.speaker: Guard
